# NS WorkLink — Job Management Guide
## Option A — Admin Panel (recommended)
Open `admin.html` in your browser.
**Default login credentials:** - Username: `admin` - Password: `nsworklink2025`
> To change the password, open `admin.html` in a text editor and find these two lines near the top of the `<script>` section: > ```js > const ADMIN_USER = "admin"; > const ADMIN_PASS = "nsworklink2025"; > ``` > Change the values and save.
### What you can do in the admin panel: | Action | How | |---|---| | Add a job | Click **"+ Add new job"**, fill the form, click **Save job** | | Edit a job | Click **Edit** next to any listing | | Remove a job | Click **Remove** → confirm | | Move a job up/down | Use the ▲ ▼ arrows — controls the order on the website |
Changes take effect immediately on the main website (`index.html`).
---
## Option B — Edit jobs.js directly
Open `jobs.js` in any text editor and add a new block inside the `JOBS_DATA` array:
```javascript { "id": 9, // unique number "title": "Your Job Title", "company": "Company Name", "initials": "CN", // 2-letter logo "logo": "blue", // blue | green | orange | purple | pink | dark "location": "Kigali, Rwanda", "type": "Full-time", // Full-time | Part-time | Contract | Internship | Freelance "workplace": "Hybrid", // Remote | Hybrid | On-site "experience": "Entry level", // Entry level | Intermediate | Experienced "posted": "Posted 1 Jan 2025", "salary": "RWF 200,000 / month", "applyUrl": "https://yourcompany.com/apply", "description": "One sentence about the role.", "responsibilities": ["Task one.", "Task two.", "Task three."], "requirements": ["Requirement one.", "Requirement two."] } ```
> **Note:** If you have previously used the admin panel, jobs saved there (in browser storage) take priority over `jobs.js`. To reset to the `jobs.js` data, open the browser console on the main site and run: `localStorage.removeItem("nsworklink_jobs")`
---
## How jobs are stored
- The admin panel saves jobs to your **browser's localStorage**. - `jobs.js` is the **default/fallback** data used on first load or in a fresh browser. - Both the main site and admin panel share the same localStorage key: `nsworklink_jobs`.
